the dietary habits of renal transplant recipients are not in line with the dietary guidelines and that their nutritional status is not optimal.

the nutritional status and dietary habits of renal transplant recipients.
the nutritional status of renal patients and their dietary habits.
the nutritional status of renal transplants patients, the nutritional status of patients who underwent renal transplant surgery and the dietary habits of patients who have been transplanted.
